output.objective: In April of 1977, who was the Prime Minister of the first place mentioned by name in the Book of Esther (in the New International Version)?

queries.query: Book of Esther first place mentioned New International Version
Book of Esther chapter 1 NIV location first mentioned
Esther 1:1 NIV text "from India to Cush" first place mentioned
Book of Esther chapter 1 verse 1 2 NIV Susa citadel first place name
Esther 1:1-2 NIV exact wording first location

gaps: The first place mentioned by name in the Book of Esther (NIV) needs to be identified. Esther 1:1 mentions 'Xerxes' (Ahasuerus) who ruled over 127 provinces from India to Cush/Ethiopia. The first place name mentioned is likely 'India' or 'Cush' (Ethiopia), or possibly 'Susa' (the capital). Need to confirm the exact first place name in Esther 1:1-2 NIV.
Need to determine which country corresponds to that first place name (e.g., India, Ethiopia, or Persia/Iran).

Need to identify who was the Prime Minister of that country in April 1977. If the place is Persia/Iran, the Prime Minister in April 1977 was Amir-Abbas Hoveyda (who served until August 1977), but this needs confirmation. If the place is India, need the Indian PM in April 1977 (Morarji Desai, who took office in March 1977). If Ethiopia, need the Ethiopian PM in April 1977.
